item.title: Rwanda: Pioneering e-Procurement in Africa
item.description: Keeping the procurement process simple and cost efficient is a major challenge that every government faces. Despite best efforts, the public procurement process is often lengthy, complex, and costly.

item.title: Estonia: The Efficiency of a Digital Country
item.description: Estonia is considered the world’s most advanced digital society, with only two government services needing to be done in-person: getting married or getting divorced.
